meaningfulChallenges.topic: Early quiet gaze: craft deduction versus semantic uncertainty
meaningfulChallenges.response: B correctly challenges the inference that a subtle cue necessarily needs amplification. My G2 deduction is a limited specialist preference about the first signal’s strength in the inspected stills. It is not a remaining wrong-axis defect, a measured comprehension failure, or a mandate to make the gaze conspicuous. The eyes-before-head order is purposeful and should remain. Keep the existing hierarchy unless a matched rendered comparison establishes a gain without competing with consideration and the offer. I retain the deduction and 9.1 as independent craft judgment, while keeping semantic understanding unscored.

Agree with B that source plus actual 390 day/night reading/return samples, with 320/1440 context, close the specific old direction mismatch. This is stronger than the previous layout-only size improvement. It does not establish every-device behavior or how unfamiliar viewers interpret the scene.

meaningfulChallenges.topic: Tiny offering endpoint and Grateful/Shy proximity
meaningfulChallenges.response: I agree the current offer is clearer at scene size and that the isolated startup/reduced-motion still cannot borrow preceding movement. B’s Grateful/Shy proximity is visible in the small-size sheets I inspected: both are pale hand lobes below a ruff, and contact/asymmetry needs more space to read. I accept this as a valid additional nuance of the small-size vocabulary, not measured audience confusion. It does not supply new evidence requiring an additive deduction or a numerical change in my existing assessment. Preserve B’s separate weighting and score.

I accept B’s reading of the proposal’s smooth active retargeting as implementation continuity, bounded by the explicit continuous-perception limit. Source and frames establish return at 2350 ms and offer by 2720 ms; tests/replay records establish bounded numerical behavior. They do not establish that the wrist turn feels like one offer rather than a flick, and no rhythm score is supplied.

The character remains complete as a silent study. The recommendation that the sequence must communicate without audio is a design criterion and a bounded specialist judgment, not claimed unfamiliar-viewer comprehension. No sound or mute control is required now. Future sound needs a separate reversible choice and actual listening evidence; the current silent Play button does not grant that consent.

evidenceBasedResolution: Accept unchanged gesture/staging v1 as the implemented local foundation with the former phone direction defect closed in inspected compositions and the minor size/cue-strength differences retained. Keep both scores and all unsupported outcomes separate. No extra cue, anatomy change or audio is required to accept this scope.

remainingDisagreements.position: A keeps a minor quiet-cue craft deduction; B gives greater weight to restraint and does not treat subtlety itself as a deduction. Both oppose automatic exaggeration and agree no semantic failure has been demonstrated.
B separately deducts Grateful/Shy proximity. A accepts the observation within the already bounded small-size semantic limits without applying a new additive penalty.
A remains 9.1, B remains 9.0. No averaging or convergence is required for the shared bounded recommendation.

acceptedJointRecommendation: Keep the character silent and visually self-contained. The corrected attention and offering sequence must communicate without audio; any future sound remains optional and subordinate.
practicalSkillsWorkflowAgreement: Use an explicit silent cause map before sound: visible question, antenna/eyes lead, delayed head support, consideration, visitor return, then one small offer. Mark text, background and controls as static unless functional feedback requires change.

Keep purposeful finite character action and indefinite settled rest. Use remove-animations frequency/purpose reasoning to reject extra waves, idle loops, pulses or audio added only to showcase a refinement.
Review the initial/reduced-motion endpoint alongside the full sampled sequence; retain actual-size ladders so a strong 240 px silhouette is not promoted into a 96 px semantic claim.
Use matched before/current actual DOM phone phases for responsive causality. Simplified film composition may support pose comparison but must not replace real layout evidence.

Check displayed pose corrections and raw engine state separately for replay/resize; exercise paused/reduced-motion states and collection-wait cancellation. Keep numeric continuity separate from felt motion.
If optional sound is commissioned, create separate reversible opt-in, keep cues subordinate to visual cause, and obtain real listening/retrigger/repeat-listening evidence before audio judgments.
exceptions: Keyboard Play intentionally requests character content; preserve access instead of applying a blanket no-keyboard-animation rule.
Narrative acting retains multi-second timing; sub-300 ms UI budgets apply to feedback, not the whole character scene.
Expressive SVG anatomy and equal numeric theme poses remain; do not replace them solely to satisfy a GPU-only heuristic.
Reduced-motion stills and silent indefinite rest are valid complete presentations; no opacity effect, idle loop or soundtrack is required.
Read-only JSON review does not execute source edits, remove dependencies or replace the required review format.

Actual full skill intake is three reused Emil skills: choreograph, remove-animations, review-animations. All 17 catalog summaries were previously read; no new full design-taste, Swift, Expo or Sonner reading is claimed.

limits: Small 96/128 px offering mittens remain accents; isolated tiny stills do not establish invitation semantics. Grateful/shy hand differences also remain subtle at these sizes.

The old phone wrong-axis defect is corrected for inspected compositions. The early gaze remains a quiet signal; A retains a minor craft preference about its strength, not a demonstrated semantic failure or a demand to exaggerate it.
Continuous felt motion, wrist-turn fluency, audio quality, listening comfort and unfamiliar-human outcomes remain unsupported/unscored.
No physical-phone, GPU workload or spoken assistive-output validation. Browser/test records support bounded implementation facts.
Simplified phone-film staging is not actual DOM layout evidence. Actual phone PNGs carry the layout judgment.
Replay envelope remains inside renderer ±6 but can exceed nominal engine ±5; no strict final ±5 claim or subjective replay-smoothness claim.
Accepting this implemented local foundation does not authorize publication/deployment or certify every specialist at 9/10.
